name: Video
summary: Videos written as code: agents build promos, explainers and social clips in React (Remotion), look at frames of them with the problems found, and render them to MP4, WebM, GIF or ProRes. They show in the project's Design view.
description: Turn it on for a project whose agents should make videos. Every agent there gets the video-code skill (a video is a folder of React components that Remotion draws frame by frame: compositions and their props, timing with frames, scenes, transitions, Relay's kit of titles, kinetic text, counters, phone and window frames, taps and a pointer, word-by-word captions, moving backgrounds and four bundled font families; checking with video.check and looking with video.still, which answers a picture and the problems in it — text cut off, past the frame or under a platform's buttons, too faint, too small, overlapping, or in a font that is missing — sound on a beat grid with voice lines, music and effects (ElevenLabs, with the person's key) and checks of the mix, Android screen captures, a live preview, and rendering with video.render at a platform's loudness), the plugin's rules in its brief, the video.* tools, and write access to the project's video folders. Rendering needs Node.js 20 or newer; the first video sets up Remotion and its headless browser (about 600 MB, once, into Relay's data folder).
